content.value: Identify whether the equation xy $d x = ( x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } )$ dy is homogeneous or not. Hence (12) [CO3] solve it.

$$
\left( x ^ { 3 } + y ^ { 2 } { \sqrt { x ^ { 2 } - y ^ { 2 } } } \right) d x - \left( x y { \sqrt { x ^ { 2 } - y ^ { 2 } } } \right) d y = 0 .
$$
